name: Pause-locked copy slot
purpose: A line of copy beside a demo changes in the narration pause before the phrase that names it: fade out 0.18 s, empty 0.08 s, fade in 0.14 s, first visible 0.3 s before the phrase; warns when a swap lands on a spoken word.

implementation.api: Studio.comp.copySlot(parent, versions) -> {enter(tl, i, at), swap(tl, i, phraseStart, {lead, fadeOut, gap, fadeIn, words}), warnings, exit}

layout_notes: All versions share one grid cell, so the slot never reflows.

validation.evidence: Runtime checks tests/studio-runtime/explain-devices.html (63 checks incl. seek-order independence) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-11-28; golden scene tests/reference-derived/explain-headline-copy/index.html frame review 0 errors 0 warnings and contact sheet inspected. Not rendered through HyperFrames on the M2, so not approved.
